name: kettlebell burpee
description: A burpee that adds a kettlebell for extra load, giving you a hard full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.
